courses.title: Introduction to Reinforcement Learning
courses.imageAlt: Illustration: a small robot on a tiled gridworld, with a dashed blue route past walls and pits to a gold goal flag
paragraphs: Teddy Lazebnik's free course on how an agent learns to act by trying things and seeing what happens. It runs from the agent–environment loop, bandits and dynamic programming through Q-learning, deep RL, planning and policy gradients to learning from people. There are 12 lectures with slides, 51 animated episodes, nine labs and three games.

courses.title: Epidemic Modeling
courses.imageAlt: Illustration: a toy town on a round board where small figures are linked by glowing contact lines, with soft epidemic curves rising behind it
paragraphs: Teddy Lazebnik's free course on how models describe, forecast and help control the spread of infectious diseases, following his book Epidemic Modeling (Academic Press, 2026). Over 13 modules it goes from history and the SIR model to contact networks, mutating strains, agent-based simulation, data and policy, with 53 animated episodes, slides, 11 labs and a game.

courses.title: Symbolic Physical Laws Discovery
courses.imageAlt: Illustration: a swinging pendulum and a ball rolling down a ramp, joined by a branching expression tree to a curve drawn through measured points
paragraphs: Teddy Lazebnik's free course on discovering physical laws with computers, following his forthcoming book. Over 10 modules it goes from writing formulas as data and adding units, symmetries and known physics, through genetic programming and differential equations, to how far a discovered law can be trusted. Each module has long animated videos, slides and a browser lab.

courses.title: Computational Approaches to the Non-Observed Economy
courses.imageAlt: Illustration: a miniature market district under two searchlights, one warm and one cool, each lighting a different part of the streets and stalls
paragraphs: Teddy Lazebnik's free course on what official statistics miss: informal, underground, illegal and unrecorded production. Over 9 modules, following the forthcoming book of the same name, it builds models, audit games, size estimates with honest errors, forecasts and agent-based towns, in invented countries so every method is checked against a known truth. Each module has videos, slides and a lab.
